verdict.rationale: Lago documents a self-hosted version deployable via Docker (lago-docs-11). Its GitHub repo runs the Lago version matching a local checkout (lago-gh-1), and it describes itself as open source (lago-probe-1), corroborated by community mentions of the self-hosted option and its AGPL license (lago-comm-4, lago-comm-8, lago-comm-11). Missing for 10: in-depth production self-hosting docs (scaling, upgrades, configuration) in the evidence, and clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and the managed cloud product.
